block-guide:
CORE/ACCORDION (new in WordPress 7) A group of collapsible sections: each has a heading button and a panel of any blocks. WordPress adds the open/close behaviour itself when the page renders; write no script. REQUIRED STRUCTURE (exact) core/accordion > core/accordion-item (one per section) > core/accordion-heading, then core/accordion-panel — exactly these two, in this order, in every item. The panel holds ordinary blocks (paragraph, list, image, buttons…). MARKUP (checked in the editor)

Two to five working days.

Yes, within 30 days.

OPTIONS (on core/accordion) autoclose:true = opening one section closes the others. Default false. headingLevel (default 3), showIcon (default true), iconPosition "right"|"left": the editor copies them into EVERY accordion-heading (level, showIcon, iconPosition). Write the same values there, with the matching tag and classes (see core/accordion-heading). openByDefault is set per item (see core/accordion-item). PITFALLS The role attributes and the classes wp-block-accordion-heading__toggle and wp-block-accordion-panel are required: WordPress finds the button and the panel by these classes to make them work. The icon is the literal "+" in its span; core CSS rotates it 45 degrees on an open item. CHECK Open the page: each heading opens and closes its panel. Reopen the editor: no invalid blocks.
